readingSections.title: 1. Tokens, Character Set, Types, Operators (From Zero)
readingSections.quickSummary: Programs are built from tokens: keywords, identifiers, literals, operators. Types fix size and meaning. Operators have strict precedence with postfix on top.
content: Character set: letters, digits, whitespace, and symbols plus escape sequences (\n newline, \t tab, \0 null terminator, \ backslash). ASCII codes 0-127 (digits 48-57, A-Z 65-90, a-z 97-122); Unicode extends the idea worldwide. VEDA's char-type program (digit/lower/upper/special) is ASCII-range logic.

Tokens: keywords (32 classic reserved words like int, if, while - cannot be identifiers), identifiers ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, case-sensitive, no leading digit), literals/constants (integer 10/010 octal/0x10 hex, float 3.14/1e-3, char 'a', string "hi" with hidden \0), operators and punctuators.

Builtin types and typical sizes (x86-64 Linux, the exam assumption; short is 2): char 1, short 2, int 4, long 8, float 4, double 8, pointers 8 bytes. Modifiers signed/unsigned/short/long shift range. Scope: block locals die at }, globals live whole program, static locals persist between calls, extern shares across files.

Operators by precedence (high to low): postfix () [] . -> expr++ expr-- (HIGHEST - VEDA sample answer), then unary (! ~ ++x --x (type) * & sizeof, right-to-left), multiplicative (* / %), additive (+ -), shifts, relational, equality, bitwise (& ^ |), logical (&& ||), ternary (?:), assignment (right-to-left), comma (lowest). Associativity breaks ties: most group left-to-right; unary/ternary/assignment group right-to-left.

subsections.title: The two sample blanks, solved
content: Memory of short int: typically 2 bytes (16 bits). State the platform assumption; VEDA expects 2.
Highest precedence above all operators: postfix - function call (), subscript [], member . ->, postfix ++/--. Any of () or [] is the accepted answer.

example.prompt: Memory of short int? Highest-precedence operator?
steps: short is 16-bit on the assumed platform: 2 bytes.
Postfix group (function call, subscript) binds tightest.

subsections.title: Literal traps
content: Leading 0 means octal: 010 is 8, not 10. 0x prefix is hex.
'a' is an int-valued char constant; "a" is a 2-byte array (a plus \0).
Integer division truncates: 7/2 is 3. Use 7.0/2 for 3.5.

subsections.title: Scope and storage in one paragraph
content: auto locals: born and die per block. static locals: born once, remember. register: hint only. extern/global: shared, zero-initialised.
Uninitialised locals hold garbage - the classic output-question trap.

readingSections.companyNote: Both official C sample blanks live here - free marks if memorised.

readingSections.title: 2. Control Flow and Functions
readingSections.quickSummary: if/switch choose, loops repeat, break/continue steer. Functions declare, define, and call - recursion stacks frames until the base case.
content: Selection: if/else-if/else chains conditions; switch jumps by constant integer/char cases with break to stop fall-through (missing break falls into next case - favourite output trap). Loops: while checks first (zero trips possible), do-while checks last (runs once), for packs init/test/step. break exits the loop/switch, continue skips to next iteration, goto jumps (avoid).

Functions: declaration/prototype (return type, name, params) before use; definition holds the body; call/ invocation passes arguments by value in C (copies - callee cannot change caller ints, but CAN change pointed-to memory). Return delivers one value (or none for void). Libraries (stdio.h, stdlib.h, string.h, math.h with -lm) declare ready-made functions.

Recursion: function calling itself with a shrinking argument plus a base case that stops. Each call pushes a frame (locals + return address); base case unwinds with answers. Trace with a call tree or stack table, never by guessing. Missing base = stack overflow.

VEDA char-type program shape: read a char (getchar/scanf %c), test ranges ('0'-'9' digit, 'a'-'z' lower, 'A'-'Z' upper, else special) with if/else-if, print the class. ctype.h gives isdigit/islower/isupper/ispunct directly.

subsections.title: Switch fall-through drill
content: No break: execution slides into the next case body, including default.
Trace case-by-case downward from the matched label, collecting prints.
Deliberate fall-through groups cases (1,2,3 sharing code) - read carefully.

steps: No break: fall to case 3: print C.

subsections.title: Recursion trace habit
content: Write the stack: args per frame, return values bubbling up.
Count calls for complexity talk (factorial n calls, naive fib exponential).
Check base first: n<=1 return before recursing.

subsections.title: Call-by-value consequence
content: swap(a,b) with plain ints cannot work - copies swap, originals stay.
swap(&a,&b) with pointers works - dereference writes caller memory.
Arrays decay to pointers, so array arguments CAN be modified.

quickRevision: Missing break falls through. while-first, do-once.
Args by value; pointers share memory.
readingSections.companyNote: Output tracing on switch/loops/recursion is the mains C core.

readingSections.title: 3. Arrays, Strings, Pointers, Dynamic Memory
readingSections.quickSummary: Arrays are contiguous same-type cells. Strings are char arrays ending in null. Pointers hold addresses; p+1 steps one element. malloc asks the heap at runtime.
content: Single-dimensional: int a[5] holds a[0..4]; out-of-range access is undefined (no bounds check - silent corruption). Initialiser int a[5]={1,2} zeroes the rest. Multidimensional int m[2][3] is row-major: m[i][j] sits at base + (i*3+j)*4 bytes; rows are contiguous.

Strings: char s[]="hi" stores h,i,\0 (3 bytes). %s prints to \0; missing terminator overruns. string.h: strlen (length without \0), strcpy/strncpy copy, strcat/strncat join, strcmp (0 equal, <0 less, >0 greater), all byte-wise by ASCII.

Pointers: int *p = &x stores x's address; *p reads/writes x. Arithmetic scales by type: p+1 moves sizeof(*p) bytes. Array name decays to &a[0] (except sizeof/&): a[i] IS *(a+i). Pointer subtraction gives element distance. char * vs char[]: pointer reassignable, array fixed base.

Dynamic: malloc(n) raw bytes (garbage), calloc(n,sz) zeroed, realloc grows/moves, free returns. Always check NULL, free exactly once, never touch after free (dangling). sizeof computes sizes at compile time (operator, not function).

subsections.title: The five pointer facts
content: & gives address, * follows it. p+1 steps an element, not a byte.
a[i] equals *(a+i). &a[i] equals a+i.
Strings end at the first \0 - strlen counts before it.
Uninitialised pointers (wild) must never be dereferenced.
free(NULL) is safe; double-free is undefined.

subsections.title: 2D address drill
content: Row i starts at B + i*cols*size. Columns add one element each.
Passing m to functions needs all dims but first: f(int m[][3]).

subsections.title: malloc pattern
content: int *p = malloc(n*sizeof *p); if(!p) fail-path; use; free(p); p=NULL.
sizeof *p (not sizeof(int)) survives type changes.
calloc for zeroed arrays; realloc result into a temp (keeps old block on failure).

quickRevision: p+1 steps sizeof(*p). free once, NULL after.
readingSections.companyNote: Pointer-plus-array output questions dominate C mains.

readingSections.title: 4. Structures, Unions, Enums, Bit-Fields, Bitwise Ops
readingSections.quickSummary: struct groups different types (size = padded sum). union overlays them (size = largest). enum names ints. Bitwise ops touch single bits.
content: struct {int id; char g; float f;} packs fields in order, each aligned: total is the padded sum (alignment may insert holes; typical sizes: 4+1+pad3+4 = 12). Access with . (object) and -> (pointer). Assignment copies whole structs; passing copies unless pointer given.

union {int i; float f; char c[4];} shares ONE memory block sized to the largest member (here 4): writing one field clobbers the others - read only the last-written field (type punning aside). enum {RED, GREEN=5, BLUE} names ints (0, 5, 6) for readable states and switch labels.

Bit-fields struct {unsigned a:3; unsigned b:5;} pack into ints with declared widths - layout is implementation-defined (exam sticks to width sums and simple packing). Bitwise: & and, | or, ^ xor, ~ not, << left shift (x*2^k), >> right shift. Masks: set bit (x|mask), clear (x&~mask), toggle (x^mask), test ((x>>k)&1).
Precedence caution: & and | sit BELOW ==/!=, so (x & mask) == value needs the parentheses - a legendary bug source and exam trap.

subsections.title: struct vs union in one line each
content: struct: every field has its own slot (sum + padding).
union: one shared slot (max of members).
Exam: sizeof each, and which read-after-write is valid.

example.prompt: struct{char c; int i;} vs union{char c; int i;} typical sizes?

subsections.title: Shift facts
content: x<<k multiplies by 2^k (unsigned). x>>k divides (logical for unsigned, arithmetic for signed negatives - implementation note).
Shift counts >= width are undefined - never shift 32 on int.
Masks are usually hex: 0x0F nibble, 0xFF byte.

subsections.title: Enum habits
content: Defaults count from 0; explicit = resets the counter.
Enums are ints: arithmetic allowed but style frowns.
switch over enums with all cases needs no default (but keep one defensively).

readingSections.companyNote: sizeof struct/union and mask ops are regular one-markers.

readingSections.title: 5. Files, Command-Line Arguments, Low-Level Notes
readingSections.quickSummary: fopen mode strings decide read/write/append and text/binary. main takes argc/argv. Binary I/O moves raw bytes with fread/fwrite.
content: Text modes: r (read, must exist), w (write, truncate/create), a (append/create); add + for update (r+/w+/a+). Binary adds b (rb/wb/ab): no newline translation (vital on Windows; identical on Linux). Always check FILE* for NULL, fclose when done (flushes buffers).

Text I/O: fprintf/fscanf with formats (%d %f %s %c), fgets/fputs line-safe (fgets keeps \n, guards length - prefer over gets which is removed/dangerous), fgetc/fputc chars, EOF (-1) ends loops: while((c=fgetc(fp))!=EOF). Binary I/O: fread(ptr,size,n,fp)/fwrite return item counts; fseek(fp,offset,SEEK_SET/CUR/END)+ftell reposition/measure; rewind resets.
Command line: int main(int argc, char *argv[]) - argc counts program name as argv[0]; arguments are strings (atoi/atof/strtol convert). prog 10 hi: argc=3, argv[1]="10".

Low-level notes for the syllabus line: file descriptors (open/read/write/close, unbuffered) sit under stdio streams; exit codes return to OS; stderr unbuffered for errors. One line in answers suffices unless asked deeper.

subsections.title: Mode table
content: r: read text, file must exist. w: write text, wiped/created. a: append text.
r+/w+/a+: read+write variants (w+ still truncates). rb/wb/ab: binary twins.
Wrong mode is the top file bug (write to r-stream fails NULL or UB).

example.prompt: Open log.txt to add lines, keep old content?
steps: Text: no b needed on Linux.

subsections.title: EOF loop done right
content: int c (not char) holds EOF (-1) distinctly from byte 255.
while((c=fgetc(fp))!=EOF) processes every byte exactly once.
feof checks AFTER a failed read, not before.

subsections.title: argv indexing
content: argv[0] is the program name. User args start at argv[1].
Count check: need 2 args means argc==3.
Convert explicitly: numbers arrive as text.

quickRevision: r/w/a + b for binary; + for update; NULL-check; fclose.
int c for EOF; fgets over gets.
readingSections.companyNote: File modes + argv indexing are quick prelims marks.

readingSections.title: 6. Function Pointers, Preprocessor, Output-Tracing Method
readingSections.quickSummary: Function pointers call through variables (callbacks, dispatch tables). The preprocessor edits text before compiling (#include/#define/#if). Trace outputs with a variable table, never by feel.
content: Function pointer: int (*fp)(int,int) points at matching functions (fp = add; fp(2,3) calls add). Arrays of them build menus/dispatch; qsort-style callbacks take comparators. Signatures must match exactly (return + params).

Preprocessor: #include pastes headers, #define MACRO text (with classic paren rule: #define SQ(x) ((x)*(x)) - every use and param parenthesised, else precedence/double-eval bugs), #define constants, #ifdef/#ifndef/#endif + #pragma once guard headers, #if for config, predefined __FILE__/__LINE__/__DATE__. Macros are text substitution BEFORE compiling - no type checks, no sequence points between re-evaluated args (SQ(i++) increments twice).

Output-tracing method for mains: (1) box every variable with current value, (2) walk statements in order including loop back-edges, (3) update boxes per statement, (4) copy exact printf text incl. spaces/newlines, (5) recheck ++/-- positions and break/continue targets. Two passes beat one clever glance.

Scope of this section in VEDA: recognise declarations (especially (*fp) vs *f() - pointer-to-function vs function-returning-pointer), predict small macro expansions, and write the char-class program cleanly.

subsections.title: Declaration reading trick
content: int (*fp)(int) - parens bind *: pointer to function.
int *f(int) - []/() bind tighter: function returning int*.
Clockwise/spiral rule resolves hairy ones.

subsections.title: Macro paren rule
content: Side effects double: SQ(i++) is undefined-ish - never do it.
Prefer static inline functions for type safety where allowed.

subsections.title: Char-class program (sample answer shape)
content: Read int c = getchar(). Test '0'-'9', 'a'-'z', 'A'-'Z', else special.
Print exactly one class word. Handle EOF (-1) gracefully.
ctype.h one-liners (isdigit etc.) are acceptable equivalents.

readingSections.companyNote: Declaration-reading + macro expansion are the two theory marks here.

formulas.commonMistake: Assuming sizes are universal - they are platform ABI.

formula.text: Postfix () [] . -> ++ -- bind tightest. Comma loosest. Unary/ternary/assignment group right-to-left.
Indexing is pointer addition scaled by element size. 2D is row-major.
strlen excludes terminator. strcpy/strcat copy/join. strcmp orders by bytes.

formula.text: Ask, verify, use, release, clear. calloc zeroes, realloc resizes via temp.
Struct aligns each field (holes possible). Union overlays all fields.

Count includes program name. Arguments arrive as strings.
Parenthesise the body and every parameter use. Never pass side effects.
